neighborhoods.name: Ypaopao Estates
neighborhoods.description: Established subdivision in northern Dededo with typhoon-rated concrete single-family homes, popular with military families for its short commute to Andersen Air Force Base
neighborhoods.character_notes: A car is essential; Guam Memorial Hospital in Tamuning is roughly a 20-25 minute drive south. Homes are mostly single-story reinforced concrete, which holds up well in typhoons and suits single-level living. Military rental demand (Andersen AFB and Camp Blaz) keeps the subdivision well maintained but pushes rents toward the top of the Dededo range.

neighborhoods.name: Astumbo
neighborhoods.description: Affordable-to-moderate residential district in northwest Dededo with older concrete homes, government housing areas, and the Astumbo community center and gym

housing.predominantType: Older concrete single-family homes and duplexes

neighborhoods.character_notes: One of the cheapest ways to live in northern Guam, but budget for a car and for higher utility costs in older housing stock. Petty and property crime run somewhat higher here than in gated subdivisions, so favor fenced properties. GRTA buses serve Dededo on weekday routes, but service ends by early evening and is not reliable enough to live car-free; Guam Memorial Hospital is about 25 minutes away by car.

neighborhoods.name: Micronesia Mall / NCS Area
neighborhoods.description: Commercial heart of southern Dededo around Micronesia Mall and the former NCS communications station, with condos and apartments along Marine Corps Drive close to Tamuning services
neighborhoods.character_notes: The most practical Dededo base for a retiree who wants to minimize driving: Micronesia Mall (groceries, pharmacy, bank branches) is walkable from nearby condos, and several GRTA routes converge here. Guam Memorial Hospital in Tamuning is only 10-15 minutes by car. Condo buildings such as Villa Rosario are typhoon-rated concrete with elevators, though Marine Corps Drive traffic is heavy and rents run at the top of the Dededo range.

neighborhoods.name: Yigo Village
neighborhoods.description: Guam's northernmost and largest-area village, a rural-suburban community of about 20,000 next to Andersen Air Force Base with gated townhome communities and larger-lot homes
neighborhoods.character: Rural-suburban, spacious lots, military-adjacent, quiet, green

housing.predominantType: Single-family homes on large lots and gated townhomes

neighborhoods.character_notes: The best value for space in northern Guam (median home price around $387,000, below the island-wide $462,500), but it is the most car-dependent choice on the island: Guam Memorial Hospital is a 30-35 minute drive and GRTA service is sparse. Generally regarded as a safe village with newer gated townhome options. Buy typhoon-rated concrete construction and expect to drive for every errand.
